title: TQC S.A.
description: (A release of 750 GB of data, compressed into archives for convenience.) TQC Tecnología Química Comercio S. A. specializes in providing high-quality solutions for the agricultural, veterinary, and environmental health sectors, promoting sustainable agriculture. The company aims to support the development and well-being of these sectors by offering a wide range of products tailored to their needs. With a commitment to excellence, TQC seeks to be a leading provider in Peru and other markets in South America. They work closely with farmers to exceed expectations and contribute to community growth.
